entity.summary: Australia-registered centralized cryptocurrency exchange offering live crypto trading markets through the GroveX platform.
entity.notes: The current first-party domain exposes the GroveX exchange application. Current independent exchange data identifies GroveX as an Australia-registered centralized exchange established in 2022 and reports recently updated markets and non-zero trading activity. HEI leaves launch_date null because an exact first-party launch date was not verified. The public legal-entity disclosure remains incomplete, so confidence is medium.
